LESSON: FOOD FOR SCHOOL GOING CHILDREN

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.5: Food for school going children

SECTION 1: WELCOME
